basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer living in Austin, Texas. I've been on a journey to sobriety for the past year and have found immense support in communities like 'stopdrinking'. When I'm not coding or engaging in self-improvement, I'm likely reading about history or indulging in science fiction. I dislike negativity and online toxicity. My typical online hours are late evenings after work. I'm currently single, focusing on personal growth and career advancement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a state university and have over a decade of experience in full-stack development. My interest in history and science fiction is self-taught through extensive reading and participation in niche communities.
